about: Per V/div index correction of the stock volts conversion: scope_volts = k * true_volts + b, so true = (scope - b) / k. Measured 2026-10-31 on one unit with host/tc3_cal.py against the generator DC output, whose own line (true = 0.992 * setting - 0.008 V) came from two multimeter readings (3.0 V -> 2.968 V, 1.0 V -> 0.984 V). x10: probe switch and scope selector both X10 (indices 0..6; 7..9 cannot be driven by the 3.3 V generator). x1: both X1 (indices 3..9; 0..2 are too small for the generator line's accuracy). The X10 gain error (about 3 %) is the probe plus input divider (about 10.3:1), the X1 gain is within 1 %: the numbers belong to this probe. Set TC3_CAL=0 to disable.
